title: Parents' messages
help: Parents on Telegram, newest conversation first. Tap a name to read and reply.
noParents: No parent is on Telegram yet. Give them the QR codes first.
noMic: No microphone permission. Allow it in the browser's settings.
noVoice: This browser can't record a voice message Telegram plays, so write your reply instead.
notOnTelegram: This parent isn't on Telegram any more, so you can't reply.
